calculation.description: Negative trailing three-day return normalized by the trailing 20-day daily return volatility, computed cross-sectionally at each observable date. Higher values indicate stronger short-term reversal after accounting for recent risk.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.048378), 2023-2024 (+0.023214), and 2025-2027 (+0.033582). The signal is strongest at the one-day horizon and decays materially by ten days; interpret small-universe estimates conservatively.
validation.gate: absolute daily paper IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily paper ICIR >= 0.0840
